modelHint: Open your model or try exporting the demo
drop: Drop your STL or OBJ here
mouseHint: Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom
exportSubtitle: A full turn in just a few clicks
ready: Ready. Drop a model into the window or click “Open STL / OBJ”.
initialGifNote: GIF loops forever. Start with 720 px, 5 seconds and 20 fps.
helpOpen: Open an STL or OBJ file. Your model stays on your computer.
helpOrientation: If the model is lying on its side, click X, Y or Z. STL files use Z as the up axis by default, as in most slicers.
helpView: Choose the color, background and view. Drag to orbit the camera; use the mouse wheel to zoom.
helpExport: Choose the turn duration, aspect ratio, size and format, then click “Export”.
helpFrames: PNG saves the current view. Animations begin at the selected start angle and contain one full turn without a duplicated final frame.
helpAlpha: GIF supports 256 colors and one-bit transparency. Use PNG for soft shadows on a transparent background. Videos use the selected background color.
helpVideo: MP4 requires an available H.264 encoder. If it is unavailable, choose WebM. Video export needs a modern version of Edge or Chrome.
helpGeometry: Models are not simplified or uploaded to a server. OBJ files load as single-color geometry without MTL files or textures. The app displays the 3D surface; it does not simulate printed layers.
helpLimits: File size: up to 200 MB. Processing speed depends on your computer. Keep the window open until export finishes.
helpLanguage: Change the language at the top of the window. Your choice is remembered in this browser for this file when local storage is available.
noScript: This application requires JavaScript in your browser.
webglFailed: Could not start 3D rendering. Open the file in Edge or Chrome and enable hardware acceleration in the browser settings.
emptyGeometry: The file does not contain valid model geometry.
invalidGeometry: Invalid coordinates or no triangles found.
fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 200 MB. Please use a smaller model.
invalidSTL: The STL file is empty or damaged.
truncatedSTL: The binary STL is truncated or has an invalid triangle count.
openedSTL: Model loaded. Z is the up axis; use X / Y / Z to rotate the model if needed.
openedOBJ: Model loaded. OBJ is displayed in a single color without external textures.
demoReady: Demo rook loaded. Try any export format.
videoUnavailable: Video export is unavailable in this browser. Open the app in a modern version of Edge / Chrome, or export a GIF.
mp4Unavailable: The MP4 / H.264 encoder is unavailable. Choose WebM or lower the resolution.
webmUnavailable: The WebM encoder is unavailable. Lower the resolution or choose GIF.
gifSizeLimit: For GIF, choose a size up to 1080 px. Larger sizes are available for PNG and video.
gifFrameLimit: GIF exports support up to 300 frames. Reduce the duration or frame rate.
gpuSizeLimit: Your graphics card does not support the selected size.
pngFailed: Could not create the PNG image.
exportDone: Done: {format} created. Find the file in your browser downloads, or use the link below to download it again.
exportCancelled: Export cancelled. You can adjust the settings and try again.
gifNote: GIF loops forever, up to 1080 px and 300 frames. Recommended: 720 px / 5 sec / 20 fps.
pngNote: PNG saves the current frame, with support for a transparent background and translucent shadows.
videoNote: {format}: one full turn, without audio. Transparency is replaced with the selected background color.
mp4Fallback: If H.264 is unavailable, choose WebM.
contextLost: The graphics context was lost. Reload the app after the graphics card becomes available.
exportBackground: Export is continuing. Keep the window open; processing may be slower in the background.
webmDurationMissing: The WebM duration field was not found.
